label: Realization cuts to bearer esse pass through intermediate contributors by supply induction (inference)
rule: Induction on the restricted supply derivation within a witness set of realization inputs
meaning: Classify the act as a mode. In the specified region an intrinsic derivation must yield its bearer's esse. A joint derivation either yields that esse or has a contributor still in the region, to which induction applies. A surviving derivation thus supplies the same bearer's esse. Application to real accidents needs a faithful realization interpretation.
